chapter.li: LEChapter4 Verse1 And now it came to pass that when king Benjamin had made an end of speaking the words which had been delivered unto him by the angel of the Lord, that he cast his eyes round about on the multitude, and behold, they had fallen to the earth, for the fear of the Lord had come upon them; VerseEnd Verse2 and they had viewed themselves in their own carnal state, even less than the dust of the earth.
